column1: # Coordinate convention for .npz artifacts that carry no in-file stamp.
# See src/tnwf/coords.py. Two values are legal:
#   node_lower_left_v1  x = (i + U(0,1))·dx      — carries a +dx/2 bias per axis
#   cell_centre_v2      x = (i + U(-½,+½))·dx    — already unbiased; needs no shift
# `cell_centre_v2` means "these coordinates need no further shift", which is
# true both of correctly-dithered grid samples and of coordinates that were
# never grid-binned at all (continuous ODE particles). Files generated by the
# current pipeline stamp their own convention and do not need an entry here;
# this table exists for shipped artifacts predating the stamp.
# --- Shipped demo/figure artifacts written under the v1 convention ----------
# --- Final MPS cores: no sample coordinates stored, sampled live at read time
# (the sampler is already correct, so anything drawn from them is v2).
# --- Table 2 inputs. These store `sw_unbiased`, computed with the half-cell
# correction already folded in, so the numbers they carry need no further
# adjustment. Deliberately left byte-identical by the archive migration.
